plan_notes: An attacker host was added as a lab scaffold because the IR did not define one.
Host h1 was placed on the external network as the inferred entry point (basis: initial-access action(s) a2); the source does not state its network placement. Confirm or correct it.

Host h2 is not deployed: no deployable service is known for it. Steps that act on it are not reproduced.
Host h3 is not deployed: no deployable service is known for it. Steps that act on it are not reproduced.
No port is known for service Azure Active Directory (Azure AD) (s3); it remains unreachable by default.
